name: Simplex Fabrication Welding and CNC Plasma Cutting
old_description: Hi. My name is Seth Neilson, the owner and welder/fabricator at Simplex Fabrication. 10 years ago, I bought a cheap tig welder off the internet and started teaching myself how to weld on an old Nissan I had in the garage. What started out as a hobby has slowly turned into a passion for me. I love welding and fabricating as well as innovating better ways of doing things. If you have an idea you would like to see brought to life, or you just need some cracks rewelded on your lawnmower, I am your guy.
about:
Simplex Fabrication operates from Woodbine, Maryland, where owner Seth Neilson began the business roughly a decade ago. Neilson purchased an inexpensive TIG welder online and taught himself to weld on a personal vehicle in his garage, turning a hobby into a full-time fabrication shop.

The shop provides welding, metal fabrication, and CNC plasma cutting services. Work ranges from rust repair on automotive and equipment components to one-off custom builds such as a go-kart belt sander and a climbing saddle hunting tree stand. Neilson handles all production himself, offering quotes via call, text, or email.

Customers include individual hobbyists, equipment owners needing repairs, and anyone with a concept requiring metal fabrication. Projects have spanned automotive restoration, recreational vehicle modifications, and custom outdoor gear, though the company does not list specific industry verticals.

Neilson emphasizes continuous improvement, stating he enjoys "innovating better ways of doing things." The business grew from personal passion rather than a formal business plan, with a focus on bringing customer ideas to life regardless of scale.
